_doc: Tier-0 smoke fixture for the diff_framework harness — proves the framework can spawn one runtime, replay a route matrix, and capture a transcript. NO gem dependency (uses the raw Rack-app shape via __rubyrs_http_serve_with_app on rubyrs, and an explicit ::WEBrick-free MRI mini-server on CRuby) so the harness's own correctness doesn't entangle with the Sinatra gem's availability. Full Sinatra parity matrix lives at fixtures/sinatra_hello/ once the M27 D core ships.
name: hello_smoke
